name: Grow tent 60x60x180
notes: Reflective mylar indoor tent with observation window and removable floor tray; sized for one small LED fixture.

name: SE1500 LED grow light
notes: Dimmable full-spectrum LED for 60x60-70x70 cm tents, smart-app control. 150 W nameplate - measure the wall draw and record it in real watts.

name: Carbon filter 100 mm
notes: Australian activated-carbon odour filter for a 100 mm pipe fan.

name: Carbon filter 150 mm
notes: Larger Australian activated-carbon odour filter; pairs with a 150-to-100 mm reducer when the ducting runs at 100 mm.

name: AeroStream H05 humidifier
notes: Smart ultrasonic top-fill plant humidifier (24 dB, 360-degree mist) designed for grow tents.

name: E6 clip fan 150 mm
notes: Oscillating clip-on circulation fan, 150 mm head, 10 speed levels.

name: 5-in-1 pH/EC meter
notes: LCD pen meter with automatic temperature compensation. Calibrate with 4.00/6.86/9.18 buffer powder before trusting readings.

name: Fabric pots 20 L (x5)
notes: Five 20 L non-woven fabric pots, 30x30 cm, with plant wire.

name: Royal Mix 50 L substrate
notes: Pre-fertilised soil mix; treat as hot soil - feed lightly at first.

name: Duct silencer 100 mm
notes: Insulated soundproof silencer for exhaust/pipe-fan ducting.

name: Ventilation ducting set 100 mm
notes: Rubber couplings, 150-to-100 mm reducer, galvanised connector, two 90-degree bends and hose clamps for a 100 mm extract run.

name: Trim tray set
notes: Trimming tray with 150-micron stainless mesh, two trim scissors, brush and magnifier card.

name: Humidity packs 62% (x8)
notes: Two-way humidity control for curing jars; replace when the indicator changes.

name: CalMag 1 L
notes: Calcium-magnesium additive for soft water or coco grows.

name: Top-Max 500 ml
notes: Organic flowering stimulant (liquid molasses-based bloom booster).

name: Calmag Up 1 L
notes: Organic calcium-magnesium fertiliser for growth and flowering.

name: Mycorrhiza 200 g
notes: Root inoculant powder; dust on roots or transplant holes.

name: Yellow sticky traps (x40)
notes: Sticky traps for fungus gnats, aphids, whitefly and leafminers.

name: Air purifier
notes: Room air purifier; the activated-carbon stage doubles as odour support outside the tent. Replacement filter: Core 300-RF 3-in-1 HEPA/carbon.

name: pH calibration buffers (x15)
notes: Buffer powder sachets for two- or three-point pH meter calibration.

name: Dosing syringes and pipettes
notes: 5 ml syringes and disposable pipettes for measuring feed additives.
